method: pdftoppm at 100 dpi; every page of both public PDFs and both private Chinese PDFs inspected at full page on 2026-10-12. The build fails on orphans, split number-unit pairs and line-initial CJK punctuation (typography_issues); all four variants pass. Latest change, the purple and gold palette (theme.json "royal"): headings, bullets, numbers and links in royal purple, rules in a light gold; all six pages (English academic 1-2, English internship 1, Chinese academic 1-2, Chinese internship 1) were inspected at full page: layout unchanged, no clipping, overlap, orphan, missing glyph or abnormal break. The Chinese current-research line breaks after its first clause by design (build_cv.py replaces the first "；" with a line break).
html_visual_qa: not separately reviewed; HTML CVs are unlinked companions of the PDFs
